description: A studio marketing executive must approve the final launch package for the first teaser campaign of the scripted series Harborline, including the music, launch date, runtime, warning language, and social-media delivery specifications.

shared_context.S1: The current draft Harborline teaser is planned as a paid digital campaign with a companion vertical social-media file.
shared_context.S2: The draft uses a popular licensed song, runs 45 seconds, is tentatively dated May 12, and contains footage of the lead actor.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to approve or reject the launch package.
shared_context.S4: At the package-lock meeting, the music, publicity, standards, and digital-delivery representatives each give a clearance update before Mara signs the final package.

PF1.text: Luis confirmed with the publisher this morning that the popular song is licensed for only a 15-second excerpt in unpaid editorial posts and cannot be used in a paid digital trailer; the approved replacement is the original-score cue 'Low Tide Pulse.' He has not entered the revised license result in the campaign tracker yet.

PF2.text: Nia reviewed the lead actor's publicity agreement with the actor's agent and confirmed that paid promotion featuring the actor cannot begin before May 20; the campaign may use the actor's footage only if the paid launch is dated exactly May 20. She is waiting for the package-lock meeting to record the restriction in the publicity calendar.

PF3.text: Owen's standards review found that the paid pre-roll placement has a hard maximum of 30 seconds and requires the exact on-screen warning text 'Violence and mature themes.' He has not yet marked the 45-second draft as rejected in the review system.

PF4.text: Keiko's completed platform ingest test confirmed that the companion social file must be exactly 9:16 vertical with captions burned into the image and audio normalized to -16 LUFS; the current delivery request still says landscape, optional captions, and platform-default audio.

acceptance_conditions: The paid teaser must use the approved original-score cue 'Low Tide Pulse' instead of the popular song.
The paid campaign must launch exactly on May 20.
The teaser must be exactly 30 seconds long.
The teaser must display the exact warning text 'Violence and mature themes.'
The companion social file must be exactly 9:16 vertical with captions burned into the image and audio normalized to -16 LUFS.
A music-rights replacement commitment must be logged.
The actor publicity restriction must be logged.
A digital-delivery specification commitment must be logged.
The music-license fact must be cited in Mara's justification after being stated aloud.

content_checks.C1: decisions['music_choice'] in ['Low Tide Pulse', 'Low Tide Pulse (original-score cue)', "Original-score cue Low Tide Pulse"]
content_checks.C4: decisions['warning_text'] in ['Violence and mature themes', 'Violence and mature themes.']
content_checks.C6: decisions['social_captions'] in ['burned-in', 'burned into the image', 'burned into image']
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['music_update', 'tracker_update', 'music_license_update'] and 'Low Tide Pulse' in c['detail'] and ('tracker' in c['detail'] or 'license' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['publicity_update', 'calendar_update', 'publicity_calendar_update'] and 'May 20' in c['detail'] and ('calendar' in c['detail'] or 'restriction' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['delivery_update', 'delivery_request_update', 'delivery_spec_update'] and '9:16' in c['detail'] and ('burned-in' in c['detail'] or 'burned into' in c['detail']) and '-16 LUFS' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The publisher's restriction changes the music from the popular song to the exact replacement cue 'Low Tide Pulse' and creates the required rights-replacement commitment.
The publicity agreement changes the paid launch date from May 12 to exactly May 20 and requires the actor restriction to be recorded.
The standards review changes the teaser runtime from 45 to exactly 30 seconds and adds the exact warning text 'Violence and mature themes.'

The platform ingest test changes the social delivery from landscape with optional captions and default audio to exactly 9:16, burned-in captions, and -16 LUFS, requiring the digital specification commitment.
